layman_headline: Solana is up 6% and approaching our profit target — hold tight, but tighten the safety net.
layman_explanation: We bought Solana at about $101 and it's now at $107, putting us up around 6%. The broader crypto market is rallying strongly with Bitcoin up 12% in a week, and Solana has been one of the best performers with a 24% weekly gain. Our profit target of $115 is within reach, but the market mood is getting greedy and many coins have already run hard. Rather than chase new positions into an extended rally, we're holding what we have and raising our stop-loss to lock in some gains.
layman_action: If you hold Solana, keep it but raise your mental stop-loss to around $98 to protect most of your gains. Don't open new positions right now — the market has moved too fast and a pullback is likely before the next good entry.
expert_reasoning: The entire market has moved aggressively — BTC +12% in 7 days, SOL +24%, ZEC +43%, VET +43%. Fear & Greed at 71 and trending toward 'worsening' greed suggests overextension risk. All swing candidates show negative composite signal scores due to extended price action and high BTC dominance at 59.2%. SOL's position is performing well at +6.2% unrealized, and with the exit target at $115 only ~7% away, the prudent move is to hold and trail the stop-loss up from $92 to $98 to lock in breakeven-plus. Opening a new position into candidates that have already rallied 30-40% in a week with no RSI/MACD data and in a high-greed environment would be chasing. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech adds event risk that could trigger a reversal.

market_context: The crypto market is in a strong rally week with BTC up 12% and major alts surging 10-25%+. Fear & Greed at 71 (Greed) suggests the move may be getting extended, and the upcoming Jackson Hole speech adds meaningful event risk.
context_banner: Market is running hot after a powerful weekly rally — protect gains on SOL and wait for a pullback before adding new positions.
